name: almond_lens
theme: a California almond orchard at hull-split on a hot late-July afternoon, read as THE LENS OF OVERLAP at every scale: two discs laid partly over each other with the almond in their crossing. The climb runs from the outer arm of a spiral galaxy, a yellow sun, the Earth's day face with the Central Valley as a tan trough, the valley floor ruled into orchard blocks, down to the dusty orchard floor and its commons, onto one bough, into one split hull and its pitted shell, the shell's stone cells, the lignin net of their walls, one carbon atom of a lignin ring, and the almond fireball of two nuclei meeting off-centre, which seams up into two galaxies overlapping on one line of sight. Palette family: hull sage & July cobalt (hard afternoon daylight).

registers.name: arm_clouds
registers.palette: blue-white star clouds, sooty black dust, magenta nebula knots, one yellow sun on ink-black space
registers.scene: the outer arm of a spiral galaxy seen from within in deep space, two broad clouds of blue-white stars laid partly over each other, a sooty dust lane crossing where the two clouds overlap, magenta nebula knots strung along the arm, countless faint stars scattered through the dark, a single yellow sun standing out near the clouds' edge
registers.loop_target: two overlapping clouds of blue-white stars in a galaxy's arm

registers.name: yellow_sun
registers.palette: hard yellow sunlight, cobalt-black space, a blue-and-tan world, a slate-grey moon
registers.scene: a yellow sun burning in cobalt-black space at the heart of its planetary system, a few planets set around it on their orbits, the nearest a blue-and-tan world lit on its day face, a small slate-grey moon whose disc is laid partly over the planet's rim, a scatter of distant stars behind

registers.name: valley_trough
registers.palette: tan valley floor, snow-white mountain crest, dun coast hills, cobalt ocean, deep blue-black space at the limb
registers.scene: the Earth's day face seen from orbit over western North America in dry clear air, California's Central Valley a long tan trough running north to south, the snow-white crest of the Sierra Nevada along its eastern side and the dun folds of the Coast Ranges along its western side, the cobalt Pacific beyond the coast, the curved limb of the planet against deep blue-black space

registers.name: orchard_blocks
registers.palette: sage-green orchard rows, khaki dirt roads, two emerald pivot circles, a silver canal, dark windbreaks
registers.scene: the floor of California's Central Valley seen from high above at a slant on a hot July afternoon, ruled into rectangular orchard blocks of sage-green almond trees in tight parallel rows, khaki dirt roads and dusty headlands framing each block, two round emerald pivot fields laid partly over each other at their edges, a straight silver irrigation canal ruling across the blocks, farmsteads sheltered by dark windbreak trees

registers.name: orchard_floor
registers.palette: sage-green canopy, khaki dust floor, hard cobalt sky, scrub-jay blue, mustard yellow, black drip lines
registers.scene: the dusty floor of a California almond orchard at hull-split under a hard cobalt afternoon sky, seen low along a row, sage-green trees hung with split hulls on both sides, khaki dust and fallen hulls on the ground, scrub jays with nuts in their beaks on the lower boughs, a ground squirrel upright beside its burrow, a kestrel perched on a steel irrigation standpipe, a gopher snake stretched along the berm, a tarantula hawk wasp at a patch of yellow mustard flowers, a coyote at the far end of the row, black drip lines along the trunks

registers.name: split_hulls
registers.palette: velvety sage-green hulls, cinnamon-tan pitted shells, khaki-dusted leaves, hard cobalt sky
registers.scene: a laden almond bough at hull-split in hard afternoon sun, clusters of velvety sage-green hulls each parted into two halves about its nut, the pitted cinnamon-tan shells showing in the almond-shaped openings, narrow leaves dusted khaki, a hard cobalt sky behind the bough

registers.name: stone_cells
registers.palette: russet and cinnamon cell walls, cobalt-blue canal threads, sage-green glints, deep umber shadow
registers.scene: the interior of an almond's shell, a packed mosaic of round stone cells set wall to wall, each cell's wall so thick its hollow is a pinprick, branching canals fanning out from each hollow to the cell's rim, the walls in layered russet and cinnamon bands, cobalt-blue light glinting in the canals, deep umber shadow in the seams of the mosaic

stage.element: a stone cell, a round bead of banded russet and cinnamon stone, cobalt-blue canals branching from a pinprick hollow, sage glints on its polish

registers.name: lignin_net
registers.palette: violet and sage ring units, cream-white cellulose cables, deep brown-black depth
registers.scene: inside the wall of a stone cell, a dense random mesh of small six-sided rings joined one to another by short links, no repeat anywhere in the mesh, the mesh grown through and around a bundle of straight cream-white cellulose cables, the rings glinting violet and sage against deep brown-black depth

stage.element: a lignin ring, a six-sided violet ring of soft velvet, sage light glowing through its open centre, one short cream link at each corner

registers.name: carbon_atom
registers.palette: cobalt-blue electron fog, a white-hot point, dim sage glows, black depth
registers.scene: one carbon atom of a six-sided ring, a soft cobalt-blue fog of electrons in two nested shells about a tiny white-hot point, the neighbouring atoms of the ring dim sage glows at the edges of the frame, deep black depth all around

stage.element: a carbon atom, cobalt-blue vapour gathered in two nested translucent shells around one white-hot point, a faint sage edge on the outer shell

registers.name: almond_fireball
registers.palette: orange-white fireball, cobalt-blue disc crescents, scarlet sparks, black void
registers.scene: two heavy nuclei flattened into thin glowing cobalt-blue discs, meeting off-centre in a black void, only the almond-shaped overlap where the two discs cross ignited into an orange-white fireball of loose sparks, the sparks squirting hardest out of the overlap's two narrow points, the unstruck crescents of each disc dark at the sides

stage.element: a fireball droplet, a scarlet bead of cracked molten lava, orange-white heat bleeding from its fissures, a cobalt-blue crust on one side

registers.name: overlap_pair
registers.palette: gold galactic glow, sooty black dust lanes, cobalt-blue spiral arms, scattered ruby galaxies on ink-black
registers.scene: two spiral galaxies on one line of sight in deep space, the nearer face-on spiral laid partly over the farther one, its sooty dust lanes silhouetted black across the farther galaxy's gold glow, the almond-shaped overlap at once the brightest and the darkest place in the frame, cobalt-blue star clouds strung along the nearer spiral's arms, small ruby galaxies scattered far behind
